{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: dox

on:
  push:
    branches:
    - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
    - main

jobs:
  build:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - uses: krdlab/setup-haxe@v1
      with:
        haxe-version: 4.2.3
    - uses: actions/checkout@v1
    - name: Cache dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: |
          ~/.haxelib
          nodejs_bin
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-haxe-4.2.3-dox-nodejs-v1
    - name: Install dox
      run: haxelib install dox
    - name: Get Submodules
      run: git submodule update --init --recursive
    - name: Get Node.js
      run: |
        if [ ! -d nodejs_bin ]; then
          git clone https://github.com/Kode/nodejs_bin.git --depth 1
        fi
    - name: Setup Node.js
      run: nodejs_bin/copysysbin.sh
    - name: Create documentation
      run: nodejs_bin/node make.js empty --kha . --from Tests/Empty
    - name: Clone website
      run: git clone -b gh-pages https://github.com/Kode/Kha.git Kha-pages
    - name: Remove old documentation
      run: rm -r Kha-pages/api
    - name: Copy new documentation
      run: cp -R build/pages Kha-pages/api
    - name: Set name
      run: git config --global user.name "Robbot"
    - name: Set email
      run: git config --global user.email "robbot2019@robdangero.us"
    - name: Add documentation
      run: git -C Kha-pages add .
    - name: Commit documentation
      id: commit
      continue-on-error: true
      run: git -C Kha-pages commit -m "Update documentation to $GITHUB_SHA."
    - name: Push documentation
      if: steps.commit.outcome == 'success'
      continue-on-error: true
      run: git -C Kha-pages push https://Kode-Robbot:$ROBBOT_PASS@github.com/Kode/Kha.git gh-pages
      env:
        ROBBOT_PASS: ${{ secrets.ROBBOT_PASS }}",
  "rationale": "The workflow repeatedly downloads dependencies on every run (haxelib install dox and git clone of nodejs_bin) with no caching. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern, supported by the measured experiment experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9, shows that caching dependency downloads reduces CI time. A cache step is inserted after checkout, keyed on runner OS and pinned dependency versions, storing ~/.haxelib and nodejs_bin. The Get Node.js step is guarded to clone only when the directory is absent, preserving identical behavior on cache hits and misses. No permissions are weakened, no new secrets or network access are introduced, and all existing build and deploy steps are retained.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9"]
}
